description: Compute experimental pristine reference (mean of 462 IQS pristine cases) and use it for CFDAC + indicators on experimental data, instead of the synth pristine mean. Modal / frf_mag / timeseries unaffected.

type.cell: best shifted from cnn2d/cfdac_mag to mlp/modal; per-cell mixed (cnn2d/cfdac_phase +0.115, cnn2d/cfdac_imag -0.132)

notes: 3/5 tasks improve; mass_location +0.25 is the largest single lift. Type regresses because synth-trained CFDAC backbones partly exploited the synth-vs-synth ref bias as a cross-domain shortcut; this drops to be recovered after backbones retrain on aligned features (P1). Modal/frf_mag/timeseries unchanged confirms the fix is surgical and only touches reference-dependent features.

description: Add sigmoid squash to all 5 torch regression heads (MLP, Conv1D, Transformer, Conv2D, Conv3D) gated on (regression AND bounded_output). Severity targets are normalized [0,1] per type (tasks.py:60), so the squash is correct; indicator predictors target raw unbounded values, so bounded_output=False is forwarded from train_indicator_predictors.py and the eval routine. State dicts unchanged -- existing .pt artefacts load and run with the new sigmoid post-hoc.

severity_detail.cells_finite: 17/17 vs 13/17 in baseline (some were overflow large negatives)

notes: Severity goes from best=-0.020 (R^2) to best=+0.180 -- a +0.20 lift from a single line of code per model. Catastrophic MLP failures (R^2 ~ -10^22) collapse to mundane negative R^2 (-1.2). Indicator predictors correctly get bounded_output=False so their raw unbounded predictions are surfaced (this is the truth -- they were never trained with target normalization; that's a P1 problem).

description: Per-domain scaler refit. _build_scalers in evaluate_full_experimental.py now accepts source='exp_pristine' which fits each StandardScaler on the 462 IQS Pristine cases instead of the synth train fold. The classifier decision boundary is unchanged; only the input whitening shifts so MLP/sklearn cells see inputs centered where the experimental data live. Wired through a --scaler-source CLI flag; default flipped to exp_pristine. Skipped the planned 'add indicators to FEATURES_FLAT' step -- no *_indicators.pt artefacts exist; the report explicitly removed indicators-as-input.

binary.cell: mlp/modal becomes the new best (was cnn2d/cfdac_all)

type.cell: best slides from mlp/modal to cnn2d/cfdac_mag

severity_R2.cell: best cnn/timeseries unchanged (not a flat-feature cell)

notes: Where the StandardScaler is in the prediction path (MLP / sklearn on 'modal'), the exp-Pristine scaler dominates -- severity MLP/modal goes from -1.165 to +0.055 (+1.2 lift, the biggest single-cell improvement in the whole sweep so far). Mass-location MLP/modal +0.12. Col/type MLP/modal regress slightly because their decision boundary doesn't survive the input shift cleanly. Overall best-per-task is essentially unchanged because deep cells (Conv2D/Conv3D on CFDAC) dominate the top of every task and don't go through this scaler at all. The fix is a net win and is now the default.

description: P0.4: split FEATURES_SEQ in train.py into FEATURES_SEQ (training: frf_mag only) and FEATURES_SEQ_ALL (legacy: frf_mag + timeseries). Future training stops producing *_timeseries.pt cells since on experimental data timeseries is fabricated from H(f)*F(f)->IFFT and carries no info beyond frf_mag. The report builder build_report_sections.py now flags every experimental `timeseries` row with '(exp value is synthesised from FRF; not an independent feature)'.  P0.5: features.compute_frfs now guards X with np.where(|X|>1e-12, X, 1e-12) so a future change to CHIRP_F_LO below 1 Hz cannot inject NaN/Inf into every downstream feature silently.
notes: P0.4 has no immediate ablation impact -- existing artefacts are still evaluated; the change takes effect when synth backbones retrain (P1). The report flag is documentation. P0.5 is a fragility guard with zero numerical effect today (synth chirp starts at 2 Hz, exp bins start at 0; |X| at 0 Hz is the chirp's DC component which is non-zero, ~1e-3). Both are merged together as a small infrastructure commit; the next ablation row will be P1.1 (per-sample normalisation + retraining).
